title: Signature Graphics / consistent scaling
slide_intent: Keep related graphics at a common scale so a collection reads as one coherent scene.
strategic_value: Consistent scale and detail can make DB landmark combinations feel intentional.
demonstration: A consistent pale skyline is compared with a crossed-out set of mismatched landmark sizes.
practical_value: Combine graphics at the same scale and detail level.

content_islands.name: Consistent set
content_islands.spec: Place matching-scale pale landmarks at left.

content_islands.name: Mismatched set
content_islands.spec: Cross out the differently scaled combination at right.

reference_purposes.Constraint: Signature graphics may be combined at the same size and detail level, not at different scales.
reference_purposes.Application: The positive/negative pair demonstrates the distinction.
